input_messages.content: Hi, I need some help with returning or canceling a bunch of stuff I bought recently. I got into gaming, but now I want to keep only the things I actually need for that. Can you help me with this?
Sure, my email is mia.garcia2723@example.com. Let me know what else you need from me.

Honestly, I just want to return or cancel everything that isn’t related to gaming. I’m not sure about all the order numbers, but is there a way you can check my recent purchases and help me sort out what can be returned or canceled? I’d really appreciate it.
Actually, I want to keep the keyboard and the mouse. Please help me return or cancel everything else. And if possible, I’d really prefer the refund to go to my PayPal. Can you do that?
Yes, that’s exactly right. Please go ahead and start the return for those items, and make sure the refund goes to my PayPal. Thanks!
